english: …So this is Dokoka Town?\nIt has a strange atmosphere.
Shirayuki-chan, do you sense something?
I can't say exactly what's different, but\nit feels different from the world I was in.\nLike it has no life…
Oh, the shrine maiden's intuition?
Enough chatter.\nI have something important to discuss.
Ah, sorry Houki-chan.\nAbout moving between worlds, right.
Did you figure something out, indeed?
Like, 'I want yakiniku for dinner!'
I just realized,\nHouki-san is surprisingly smart, isn't she?
'Surprisingly'!? I'm exemplary in conduct!\nAnd my grades are respectable!
…Anyway, listen.\nThe fact that we ended up somewhere completely different\nfrom the other teams means something is changing it.
From what everyone's said,\nthat seems to be the case.
Ah, maybe!
Haruka, do you have an idea?
Yeah, remember when Houki-chan\nwent to Koto-chan's world before.
When I was chasing Riko Mine\nand got caught in the transfer?
Right. At that time, Cecilia-chan wished\nwith all her heart to save Houki-chan.\nAnd then she was able to follow…
So she came to Kyouto?
Yeah. So maybe the feeling of wanting to go somewhere\nchanges the destination?
So you're saying we can go\nwherever we wish to go?
Yeah!
Ridiculous.\nThings can't be that convenient.
But that's how she got to Kyouto, right?\nIf so, Haruka-san might be right?
That's like saying if you pray to god,\nyour wish comes true.
People's wishes are a strong force.\nIt's not strange that wishing\ncould decide the destination.
Right, Red Angel said\nthat Twin Angel's power\nis a mysterious thing too.
Hmm…
Riddles like this\nare usually pretty simple, aren't they?
This is turning into me sounding like\nthe crazy one… no,\nI'M the one making sense here!
Let's try it, indeed.\nWish strongly for the place\nHouki-san wants to go, indeed!
Then let's try it!\nIf Houki-san does it and it works, you'll believe, right?
That's a good idea!
I'll leave it to you.
If you insist… I'll try.
The place I want to go, strongly…!
The place I want to go… it's…!
This is where you wanted to go, Houki?
How is it? Is this right?
We really came to IS Academy…!?
A huge success, Houki-chan!
…A fluke… it must be a fluke!\nIt can't be this easy!
But it was spot on, indeed.
So fighting spirit was the key after all!
Once isn't enough evidence, is it?\nOne more time…
Before that, didn't Houki-san wish\nto come here for some purpose…?
Ah, right! I have to report to the academy that I'm safe\nand explain what's happened!\nEveryone, wait in the room we used before.
Huh, the classroom's normal.\nEven though IS is all mecha and stuff.
Really~\nBut if it were mecha all the time,\nit'd be exhausting.
Exactly.\nIS isn't all it's cracked up to be.
Ah, welcome back, Houki-chan!\nHow'd it go?
They said they can't believe anything I say,\nso I said I can't believe it either.\nThe teachers can figure out the rest.
Also, apparently a lot's been happening here too.\nThings in Europe are smelling of trouble.
Unidentified IS have been sighted,\nthe German army is making ominous moves-\nwar could break out any time, they say.
That's worrying…
And it's not just far-off news.\nThe French representative candidate\nwho was supposed to transfer to IS Academy has gone missing.
Missing… surely not\nthe same as us… indeed…?
That's possible.
A disappearance-there's gotta be something fishy!
Like, 'Sis, we've got a case!'? That kind of thing?
I've been ordered to continue\nacting together with you all.
Really!? We can still stay together?\nYay!
Y-yeah… I'm counting on you.
(My sister definitely decided my assignment!\nWhat is she thinking…)
There's nothing much to do today.\nEveryone, rest up.
Yay! Did you know, Koto-chan?\nIS Academy's cafeteria is delicious!
Really!? What's the menu?\nWhere do I see it?
Ahaha, what a glutton, indeed!
The ramen's delicious!\nI had it with Nico-chan before!
Then, I'll guide you to the cafeteria…
What's happening!?
From that impact, it's outside the grounds, indeed!
How dare they interrupt our meal!\nNever mess with someone's food!\nLet's go beat them up quick!
I'll go get Red Angel!
Houki-san, what about us?
We can at least go check the situation, right?
…Right. Depending on the enemy,\nthere may be things only we would recognize.\nTo the scene!
So this is the base of those IS bastards!\nI'll crush it…!
Huh!?\nSinging while fighting… the same as Hibiki-san?
A Symphogear, indeed?\nBut why is she attacking IS Academy, indeed?
Looks like a Symphogear!\nMaybe someone Tsubasa-san and Hibiki-san know?
Then let's talk her into stopping!
Careful!\nThat one has extraordinary fighting spirit…!
Let's call out and see\nif she'll negotiate.
I'll talk to her! Leave it to me!
Hey, stop this!
Who the hell are you?
You know Hibiki-chan, don't you!?\nIf she found out you were doing this,\nshe'd be heartbroken!
Hibiki...? You know Tachibana Hibiki?
Yeah, we traveled together for a while.\nUm, and you are...?
Hmph. I'll at least tell you my name.\nYukine Chris... call me Chris.
Thank you, Chris-chan.\nThat's a nice name!
Hah!? Quit the slow chitchat in the middle of a fight!
And what a wonderful song!\nI could just lose myself listening to it.
Shut up! What the hell are you!?
Someone who sings such a lovely song\ncan't be a bad person!\nStop fighting and let's talk...!
Heh, says the one who beat the hell\nout of a bunch of guys on the way here.\nTakes one to know one!
That's not true! We're fighting to protect IS Academy...!
The hell it isn't!\nWhat you're doing is just violence too!\nDon't act all righteous!
I'm not acting righteous!!
...What?
Attacking a school full of students out of nowhere,\nhurting everyone-that's wrong!\nThat's just wrong!
If that's justice, then fine!\nI've got my own justice too!
Huh...?
Whatever! In the end, whoever wins\ngets to be the right one!\nI'm gonna smash IS Academy to pieces!
I won't let you! I'll protect everyone!
[Battle resumes. Event triggers after Chris is defeated.]
Damn it... I just can't get into my groove...!
You go no further!
Chris-chan... why are you doing this?
[Event art: Chris, teary-eyed with anger]
You guys... you don't know anything...!\nYou have no idea what Europe looks like right now\nbecause of IS!
What do you mean?
Because of things like this!\nSo many people are getting hurt...!\nAnd they didn't do anything wrong!!
Damn it...!
[Event art off. Light envelops Chris; she moves to another world.]
She got away, but...\nwas that all right?
I... no, never mind.\nI don't think I can put how I feel right now into words.
Chris-chan...
[If Chris is defeated, the battle ends even if grunts remain.\n■ After battle / BG: IS Academy]
IS Academy seems to be safe.
And it seems our actions went unpunished.\nThat's fine, but...
A lot of things are bugging me~.
What that Chris girl said\nis bugging me too, you know?
While reporting, I tried to check what's happening in Europe...\nbut without solid intel,\nI just got the runaround...
That means something did happen, right?
Everyone, let's go after Chris-chan!
What!?
I can't just leave Chris-chan like this!
But how...? Oh!
Like when we came to this world,\nmaybe if we wish hard enough, we can chase after her?
[Fade to black / BG: IS Academy Arena.\nLight envelops Chris; she moves to another world.]
So this is where I jumped to Koto's world.
Thinking about everything so far,\nwe should be able to go from here, right?
If this really takes us\nto where Chris-san is...
I... I feel like we can do it!
Haruka's the one making the wish this time.
Is that okay, Houki-chan?
Yeah. Go ahead.
I hope it goes well.
Here we go!
To where Chris-chan is...!\nTake us there! Please!
[Enveloped in light. / END]
